post.body:
The 5 Biggest Mistakes Sellers Make (And How to Avoid Them!)

Selling a home is exciting, but let’s be honest—it can also be stressful. The good news? I’ve helped tons of sellers, so I know exactly what mistakes to avoid.

Mistake #1: Overpricing Your Home

Setting the right price is crucial. Pricing too high can scare off buyers, while pricing too low leaves money on the table. Get an accurate home valuation before listing.

Mistake #2: Skipping Home Prep & Staging

First impressions matter! Declutter, deep clean, and stage your home to attract buyers. Check out our Home Prep Checklist to make sure your home shines.

Mistake #3: Ignoring Curb Appeal

Your home’s exterior is the first thing buyers see. Simple landscaping, a fresh coat of paint, or updated lighting can make a huge difference.

Mistake #4: Not Marketing Your Home Properly

Listing photos, social media marketing, and real estate networks are key. I use **targeted marketing strategies** to ensure your home reaches the right buyers. See why marketing matters.

Mistake #5: Not Working With an Expert

Real estate is more than just listing a home. A trusted local agent helps with negotiations, paperwork, and closing smoothly. Learn more about working with me.

Avoid These Mistakes – Let’s Sell Your Home
